blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Social Security System (SSS) has cracked down on five employers in Pasay City over P1.14 million in unpaid workers’ contributions, which have ballooned to P3.19 million with penalties. In a statement, the SSS said the five employers incurred P2.05 million in penalties for failing to remit their employees’ monthly contributions, which totaled P1.14 million. READ: SSS orders 1,200 firms to remit P 335-M workers’ contributions The unnamed employers operate in various sectors, including management consultancy, restaurants, real estate, carwash, and gambling and betting.
